note: Conceptual/architecture lesson covering maintainability and recoverability as paired post-go-live NFRs, with Salesforce-specific tools (source control/DX, sandboxes, Backup and Restore, field history tracking). No screenshots per this course's conceptual/architecture policy. Backup and Restore's feature set (automated backups, encryption at rest/in transit, restore into org, audit logging) was verified against Salesforce's own product announcement before being stated; no specific RTO/RPO number is claimed for the native product, since that figure could not be verified against an official Salesforce source (see Lesson 12's sourcing note for the same caveat).
